records.notes: Vite + React Router v6 SPA (declarative <Route> table in src/App.tsx, lazy-loaded pages under src/pages/, settings under src/pages/settings/). ADOPTION = ZERO against the DESIGN-BASELINE: there is no src/components/archetypes/ directory and no docs/archetypes/MANIFEST.json, and `grep -rl '@/components/archetypes' src` returns nothing, so NO page can score fit 1.0 / adopted:true. Every classified route is therefore hand-rolled (0.55-0.9). IMPORTANT NUANCE: the project has its OWN mature, internal archetype program (docs/archetypes/*.md, page-inventory.md tags 73 routes A/B/C/D1/D2/E1/E2/F1/F2/G/H) and its OWN shared reference primitives -- StandardTableShell, CrudDialogSheet/Header/Body/Footer + useCrudDialogMode (@/components/shared/), HubTabs, PageHeader. These give high STRUCTURAL conformance but are a parallel system, not the design-baseline's @/components/archetypes/<slug> primitives, so they do not count as adopted under this rubric. TAXONOMY MAPPING applied: project 'B detail view' -> baseline C detail-overview; project 'D1 settings form' + create routes -> baseline B form-page; project 'D2 settings table' -> baseline D2; project 'F1 domain hub' + 'F2 tabbed settings' -> baseline F2 tabbed-settings. CRUD-DIALOG (baseline J) is not a standalone ROUTE here -- it appears as the row-edit dialog inside D2 settings tables (e.g. Categories' CrudDialogSheet), so J is folded into the D2 entries rather than scored as its own route. GROUPED-LIST (baseline K) and MATRIX-GRID (baseline M): no dedicated route; the only true matrix-grid is OrderPnlMatrixSection embedded in the /financials tab (logged in gaps). The route list above is REPRESENTATIVE/grouped -- ~73 routed pages exist; near-identical master-data D2 pages (customers/vendors/items/parts/packaging/cost-categories/charge-cost-types/offer-statuses/categories/shipping-packaging) and settings-form D1 pages were sampled rather than each enumerated. handRolled count (48) reflects classified representatives; the full app has ~73 routes all sharing the same hand-rolled-vs-baseline status. The /settings parent uses a nested SettingsLayout outlet; many legacy paths are <Navigate> redirects (excluded). Caveat: I sampled structure via imports + the project's own page-inventory.md (authoritative shape map) rather than reading every page line-by-line.

records.notes: Routes enumerated from the react-router table in src/App.tsx (BrowserRouter + <Routes>). 16 user-facing routes (excluding the /templates -> /admin/templates redirect and the index AppLayout wrapper). 7 routes adopt a baseline primitive (fit 1.0): list-with-detail (/, /admin/logs), settings-table (/speakers, /admin/users, /admin/widgets, /admin/meetings), form-page (/admin/settings). The crud-dialog archetype IS adopted but only by dialog components (SpeakerDialog, UserDialog, WidgetDialog, MeetingAgentDialog) which are not routes — they back the settings-table routes; not counted as routes. Project has 4 of the baseline archetypes locally installed (crud-dialog, form-page, list-with-detail, settings-table) but NOT detail-overview, tabbed-settings, grouped-list, or matrix-grid. The clearest unadopted-but-shaped pages are: ModelsPage (tabbed-settings F2, 0.85), three detail-overview/stat-tile pages (RecordingDetailPage 0.8, AdminDashboardPage 0.7, HealthPage 0.7) — these would benefit if a detail-overview baseline primitive is promoted. No MANIFEST.json found, so adoption was determined purely by import paths from @/components/archetypes/* or ../components/archetypes/*. handRolled count includes /settings/quick-record at borderline fit 0.5. The adoptionSummary buckets (7/8/2) sum to 17 because /admin/templates is counted both as a route entry and conceptually overlaps the /templates redirect; the 16 distinct routes break down as 7 adopted + 7 hand-rolled (fit>=0.5, non-adopted) + 2 gaps, with /settings/quick-record at exactly 0.5 treated as hand-rolled.

Next.js app router under frontend/src/app/**/page.tsx (33 page.tsx files; routes enumerated below, excluding pure redirect/util shells where noted). The project has NO design-baseline archetype adoption surface: there is no @/components/archetypes/ directory and no docs/archetypes/MANIFEST.json with the baseline slugs. The project DOES have its own docs/archetypes/*.md (e.g. frontend-ag-grid-data-grid, frontend-workspace-data-page, frontend-multi-step-wizard, frontend-structure-builder) but these are custom keys, not the design-baseline A/B/C/D2/J/K/M/F2 slugs. Therefore every structural match is hand-rolled relative to the design-baseline => all adopted:false, fit capped at <=0.9. Pages share a hand-rolled @/components/ui/page-header + @/components/ui/card shell, and grid-heavy workspace pages share @/components/workspace/ledger-grid primitives (LedgerGrid, LedgerAmountCell/LedgerLabelCell) — that's the project's own grid archetype, not a baseline one. Many workspace pages are 2-D financial grids (rows x periods/years), so M (matrix-grid) is the dominant shape. Utility/non-user-CRUD routes treated as gaps: /login (auth card), /not-authorized (error card), /print/report (PDF render shell), /assets/[id]/import (pure redirect). Asset/scenario context is read from React contexts, not route params, on workspace pages.

The project is a baseline producer, not just consumer: docs/archetypes/MANIFEST.json lists all 8 keys and grouped-list (K), detail-overview (C), form-page (B) and matrix-grid (M) were promoted_from hk-crm. Adoption is near-total: almost every user-facing route imports its primitive from @/components/archetypes/<slug>/. The one hand-rolled (adopted:false, fit 0.85) item is the cluster of company [id] sub-tabs (contacts/deals/notes/tasks/activity) which are documented-as-C detail sub-tabs but render their sections without importing DetailOverviewShell (sibling devices and assignments sub-tabs DO import primitives). The 4 gaps (/, /reports, /activity, /login) are genuinely off-rubric; the dashboard explicitly declares itself non-archetypal in-source. Total distinct user-facing route patterns ~40 page.tsx files; grouped here for brevity.

records.notes: No baseline adoption anywhere: no @/components/archetypes/* imports (grep clean), no docs/archetypes/MANIFEST.json, no react-hook-form. All 15 user-facing routes are hand-rolled with raw Tailwind + native <table>/<select>/custom modals. Counts: 15 routes total; 8 hand-rolled shape-matches (fit 0.6-0.75, adopted:false), 7 gaps (fit <0.5). adoptionSummary uses adopted=0/handRolled=8/gaps=7. Notable cross-cutting pattern: a 'two-pane reconciliation workbench' archetype recurs across 4 routes (/matching, /reconciliation, /reconciliation/employer, /reconciliation/household) and matches none of the rubric archetypes (it is two parallel selectable lists, not a 2-D matrix grid M and not row->detail A) -> strong candidate for a new baseline archetype. A 'CSV import wizard' (/) and 'charts/analytics dashboard' (/dashboard) are also unmodeled. Borderline calls: /accounts has settings-table/CRUD-dialog flavor but lives at /accounts not /settings/* so D2/J not strictly applied (kept as A); reports pages classed K (titled month sections of read-only tables) but could read as C. /reconciliations/[id] is detail-overview with in-place editing rather than purely read-only.

records.notes: All 6 user-facing routes are defined in a single <Routes> table in client/src/App.tsx (React Router v7); the project root index '/' just redirects to /projects. The project does NOT use the design-baseline: no @/components/archetypes/* directory, no docs/archetypes/MANIFEST.json, and zero imports from any archetypes path were found via grep. There is a docs/adoption-plan.md (baseline adoption appears in-progress/planned) but no archetype primitives are wired in yet. Therefore every matched page is hand-rolled (adopted:false, fit capped <=0.9). Pages KanbanPage/TaskListPage/TimelinePage/MasterTodoPage/MasterTimelinePage are thin wrappers delegating to view components under client/src/components/{kanban,task-list,timeline,master}/, which is where the real structure lives (paths reported accordingly). Notable cross-cutting primitive: client/src/components/task/TaskDetailDialog.tsx is a view+edit crud-style dialog (archetype J shape) reused by both list routes, but it is not itself a route. The two timeline routes are structurally near-identical (per-project vs master Gantt); the two list routes likewise. The kanban board is the only true gap.

synthesis.headline: The fleet's problem is overwhelmingly UNDER-ADOPTION, not divergence: only 2 of 6 projects (hk-crm, mistra) wire in any @/components/archetypes primitives, while the other 4 (brickshop-manager, controlling-app, my-finance-app, pmo) hand-roll every page despite strong structural matches. The single biggest opportunity is brickshop-manager, which has a mature PARALLEL archetype program (StandardTableShell, CrudDialogSheet, HubTabs) covering ~73 routes at high structural fidelity but zero baseline adoption — reconciling its primitives to the baseline would convert the largest hand-rolled surface in the fleet. A secondary, genuinely NEW signal: a two-pane reconciliation workbench and a matrix/ledger-grid family recur across projects and may warrant promotion.

gaps.shape: Two-pane reconciliation / matching workbench: stat tiles + two parallel selectable lists (e.g. expenses vs reimbursements/payments) where cross-list selection forms a match group; not a 2-D matrix (M) and not row->detail (A).

Analytics / charts dashboard: KPI stat-card row + interactive chart widgets (bar/pie/line/trend) with period/category filters; read-only but body is charts, not entity sections or tables, so below C threshold.
Multi-step import / data-ingestion wizard: upload -> column-mapping grid -> verification -> commit, with import/history toggle; form-like controls but a stepped flow, not archetype B.
Structure / report builder: drag-assign source items (accounts) into an editable tree of report lines, with unassigned panel, template selector, version history.
Drag-and-drop kanban board: horizontally sortable user-defined columns of draggable cards, cross-column moves via dnd-kit; neither grouped-list (K) nor matrix-grid (M) captures the interactive board.
Gantt / timeline view: fixed left task-row panel + scrollable right time-grid with date-positioned bars and dependency arrows; rows x time-columns but continuous, not a discrete interactive matrix.
Inbox / feed surface: conversation or notification/activity feed with filter chips; not a CRUD list or single-entity detail (brickshop archetype H / standalone activity feeds).
Media-capture flow: audio recorder/upload with waveform, capture button, durable upload queue or voice-enrollment prompt wizard; no list/form/detail/tab/grid shape.
Operational single-shot utility: input -> evaluate/lookup -> result + inline edit (box-checker/box-finder); not a list, form-page, or detail.
Auth / error static card: centered sign-in or not-authorized/error card; off-rubric utility shells.
Editable financial entry matrix: statement/budget/forecast lines x periods/years with per-cell numeric inputs (de-DE parse) and Save; manual-entry editor flavor distinct from a read-only matrix view.

triage.finding: hk-crm adopts all 8 baseline keys with near-total coverage (27 adopted, 1 hand-rolled) and is the baseline PRODUCER (K/C/B/M promoted_from hk-crm).
triage.action: No action. Treat hk-crm as the reference exemplar for adoption patterns.

triage.finding: mistra cleanly adopts A/B/D2/J for the 4 primitives it has installed; adoption is correct wherever a primitive exists.
triage.action: No action on adopted routes; see separate finding for its hand-rolled detail-overview/tabbed-settings pages.

triage.finding: brickshop-manager has ZERO baseline adoption across ~48-73 routes but runs a mature PARALLEL internal archetype program (StandardTableShell, CrudDialogSheet+useCrudDialogMode, HubTabs, PageHeader) with high structural conformance to A/B/C/D2/F2.
triage.action: Reconcile: map the project's own primitives to baseline @/components/archetypes equivalents (or vendor the baseline and migrate). Highest-leverage adoption target in the fleet.

triage.finding: controlling-app hand-rolls 21 routes including a large M (matrix/ledger-grid) family and F2/K/C shapes, with its own custom (non-baseline) archetype keys.
triage.action: Adopt baseline matrix-grid (M), tabbed-settings (F2), grouped-list (K) and detail-overview (C) where shape fit >=0.6; align its custom doc keys to baseline slugs.

triage.finding: my-finance-app hand-rolls A/C/K shapes (transactions, reconciliations/[id], categories, reports) with raw tables and custom modals; no archetypes, no react-hook-form.
triage.action: Adopt list-with-detail (A), detail-overview (C), grouped-list (K), and form-page (B) primitives for the matched routes.

triage.finding: pmo hand-rolls two A list-with-detail routes (task list + master todo) and a reused TaskDetailDialog (J shape) despite an in-progress docs/adoption-plan.md; baseline not yet wired.
triage.action: Execute the adoption plan: wire list-with-detail (A) into the two task-list routes and crud-dialog (J) into TaskDetailDialog.

triage.finding: mistra hand-rolls detail-overview (RecordingDetailPage, AdminDashboardPage, HealthPage, 0.7-0.8) and tabbed-settings (ModelsPage, 0.85) because those baseline primitives are NOT installed locally.
triage.action: Install/adopt detail-overview (C) and tabbed-settings (F2) primitives in mistra; the pages already match the shape.

triage.finding: brickshop's grouped/weak list-with-detail variants (action-row mobile lists, bulk-export lists, no-detail-nav data tables at 0.65-0.7) diverge from a pure table-row->detail A.
triage.action: Capture as variant axes on A (presentation: table | card-grid | action-row; detail-target: route | dialog | none) rather than forcing one table shape.

triage.finding: List-with-detail is presented as a card grid (pmo /projects, controlling dashboard-templates) instead of a table, lowering fit but serving a domain-appropriate need.
triage.action: Add a 'presentation: table | card-grid' variant axis to the list-with-detail (A) archetype; do not flatten card grids to tables.

triage.finding: Detail-overview appears in two flavors: pure read-only sections vs. detail + inline-edit / embedded action dialogs (opportunities StageControls+WinDialog, reconciliations/[id] in-place edit, validation/[caseId] Run action).
triage.action: Add an 'editability: read-only | inline-edit | action-dialogs' variant axis to detail-overview (C); keep both as conformant.

triage.finding: Tabbed detail pages (brickshop SetPreparationDetail/SharedListDetail F2-over-C, hk-crm company [id] tab nav over C) blur F2 and C.
triage.action: Document a 'tabbed detail' composition (F2 shell wrapping a C body) as an explicit allowed combination rather than a separate drift case.

triage.finding: The matrix-grid (M) family in controlling-app spans read-only ledger views, editable entry grids, comparison/variance grids, and tile dashboards — broader than hk-crm's interactive companies x services M.
triage.action: Define M variant axes (read-only | editable-cell; numeric-ledger | tile-layout | comparison) before pushing controlling-app to adopt, so the primitive can actually absorb these.

recommendedActions: Reconcile brickshop-manager's mature parallel primitives (StandardTableShell -> A, CrudDialogSheet -> J inside D2, HubTabs -> F2, settings tables -> D2, detail views -> C) to the design-baseline; this is the single largest hand-rolled surface in the fleet and already structurally conformant.

Add variant axes to existing archetypes before forcing adoption: A gets 'presentation: table | card-grid | action-row' and 'detail-target: route | dialog | none'; C gets 'editability: read-only | inline-edit | action-dialogs'; M gets 'read-only | editable-cell' and 'ledger | tile | comparison'. This converts most yellow drift into conformant variants.

Install the missing detail-overview (C) and tabbed-settings (F2) primitives in mistra and adopt them in RecordingDetailPage, AdminDashboardPage, HealthPage, and ModelsPage — the shapes already match, only the primitive is absent.

Promote a new 'import wizard' archetype (upload -> column-mapping -> verify -> commit), recurring in controlling-app and my-finance-app.

Evaluate promoting a 'two-pane reconciliation/matching workbench' archetype: it recurs across 4 routes within my-finance-app and is a clean unmodeled shape; confirm whether a second project needs it before promoting (currently single-project, so hold at candidate review).
Document an explicit 'kanban board' decision (promote or formally exclude): recurs in pmo and hk-crm (opportunities kanban view) but no current primitive models a dnd-kit board.
